comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body:
Finally someone with some creative vision! This looks sick. Love the web mechanic, is it based on setting up at least 3 points and then you can sort of automate the web after? What engine is this? Unity? Godot? Fantastic work either way.

How much was a mix of either your own assets or store assets and how much or what did the AI do for you?

replies.author: One_Low8664
replies.body: Hey, the web mechanic is indeed based on 3 points, after that the web is automated. The game was created entirely Opus 5.5. TypeScript and Three.js for spatial movement and environments, custom illustrative shaders, expressive character animation and Web Audio for responsive musical layers. All assets have been created entirely by Claude, most project was shipped by AI, it took around 4-5 prompts to get to this point. Starting a fresh project for each prompt.

replies.author: _Cybin
replies.body: Just a random suggestion, but I think it would be cool if the web building was rhythm based or something, rather than totally automatic.

replies.author: One_Low8664
replies.body: Hard to get the controls right for me, i want it playable for phone, any suggestions?

replies.author: _Cybin
replies.body:
I think it could be as simple as tapping the screen in rhythm with the song. For example, players could tap each time the spider reaches a corner of the web, with the spider’s movements synced to the beat of the music.

--
This is a really cool project by the way, definitely stick with it!

replies.author: kokutouchichi
replies.body: I like that suggestion it could even make more complex websites more interesting to build as you would have a different beat pattern as you would compared to a smaller web. I don't really know the mechanics of the web but you could maybe get some sort of bonus applied to the web if you nailed the beats correctly. Like a plus to web strength or something like that.
